headline: Fisherman's Row Heaviest Fighting; Expanse and Shelf Still Contested
war_summary: Fisherman's Row has become the busiest corner of the past two hours, fourteen base events logged there and forty-five across the day, its line now reading five Warden squares to three Colonial with one laid waste. Stlican Shelf has shifted again, now three Warden squares to six Colonial, with Breaker Town alone accounting for thirty-one events in the day. The Weathered Expanse keeps its four-to-five split under an unrelenting grind: sixty-two events in a day, five in two hours, and Warden casualties near 1,047 an hour against 552 Colonial. Callahan's Passage has gone quiet for two hours, though its day's toll of 10,697 Colonial and 13,334 Warden ranks among the war's heaviest, with twenty-nine events around The Crumbling Passage. Mooring County's fighting has eased to two events in two hours. Nevish Line holds seven Warden squares to one Colonial. Of the fifty-three regions reported, six carry more than one colour, and Colonial forces hold the great majority of the remainder.
